name: stoke
description: A bespoke desktop shell for Claude Code
author: realvinn

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-windows-identity.mjs && node scripts/build-mac-reveal.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: electron-vite build && node scripts/build-windows-identity.mjs && node scripts/build-mac-reveal.mjs && vite build --config vite.remote.config.ts && npm run build:account-remote && npm run build:terminal
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.account-remote.json

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/targets.mjs --build win-x64
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/targets.mjs --build win-arm64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/targets.mjs --build mac-arm64
scripts.dist:mac:intel: npm run build && node scripts/targets.mjs --build mac-x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/targets.mjs --build linux-x64
scripts.deploy:hub-edge: npm run build:account-remote && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy -c wrangler.hub-edge.jsonc
scripts.pack:terminal: npm run build:terminal && node scripts/package-terminal.mjs && npm pack ./out/terminal-package --pack-destination ./out/cli-release
scripts.dist:terminal: npm run build:terminal && node scripts/package-terminal.mjs && node scripts/dist-terminal.mjs
